name: Introduction and overview — B-52 Stratofortress — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — B-52 Stratofortress
description: Introduction and overview of the B-52 Stratofortress: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The B-52 Stratofortress is an eight-engine strategic bomber built by Boeing, entering service in 1955 and still flying in frontline service more than 70 years later. 744 were built. Successive upgrades — new avionics, weapons, and engines planned — are expected to keep the B-52 flying into the 2050s, nearly a century after its first flight.
